definitions.explanation: The distinctive taste and aroma of food or drink, often implying a subtle, refined, or characteristic quality. More nuanced than {味|あじ}, suggesting the overall sensory impression including both taste and smell.

examples.japanese: ⟦バター→バター：04671_bataa⟧{風味|ふうみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦クッキー→クッキー：10798_kukkii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}いた→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦チーズ→チーズ：00026_chiizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風味|ふうみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This cheese has a distinctive flavor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦{煮込|にこ}む→煮込む：05822_nikomu⟧ことで、⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風味|ふうみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}されて→引き出す：03002_hikidasu⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{味|あじ}わい→味わい：11899_ajiwai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: By simmering for a long time, the flavor of the ingredients is drawn out, creating a deep taste.

notes:
USAGE:
{風味|ふうみ} refers to the combined taste-and-aroma profile of food, suggesting a more refined or nuanced quality than ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧ alone. It is also commonly used as a suffix meaning "-flavored": ⟦バター→バター：04671_bataa⟧{風味|ふうみ}, しょうゆ{風味|ふうみ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風味|ふうみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧ (good flavor/aroma)
- {風味|ふうみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|い}かす (to bring out the flavor)
- {風味|ふうみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧ (the flavor deteriorates)
- {風味|ふうみ}⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧な (rich in flavor)
- 〜{風味|ふうみ} (-flavored: ⟦バター→バター：04671_bataa⟧{風味|ふうみ}, ガーリック{風味|ふうみ})

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {風味|ふうみ}: flavor (combined taste and aroma; refined quality)
- ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧: taste (direct taste sensation; broader usage)
- ⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧: aroma, fragrance (smell specifically)
- ⟦{味|あじ}わい→味わい：11899_ajiwai⟧: savoring, appreciation of taste (literary/poetic)
